apps/office/src/sw/source/uibase/wrtsh/native-cross-node-deletion.test.ts#replaces a multi-paragraph selection and restores its middle
semantic.justification: Retains the actual inline graphic format and moves its graphic section into Writer undo ownership, unlinks the dummy, then restores the original section and reinserts an as-character hint. Other floating-anchor deletion profiles, drawing anchors, nested fly content and section mark history, native layout frame selection, redlines, and complete SwNodes undo-array parity are unverified. For text selection deletion, retains the live floating text frame or graphic and its section when its anchor is on a completely selected middle paragraph. Undo restores the section, format, and original character or paragraph anchor.
